(2) Nothing in this regulation shall have effect in relation to—
(a) the drugs specified in Schedules 4 and 5 or poppy-straw;
(b) any drug specified in Schedule 3 contained in or comprising a preparation which—
(i) is required for use as a buffering agent in chemical analysis;
(ii) has present in it both a substance specified in paragraph 1 or 2 of that Schedule and
a salt of that substance; and
(iii) is premixed in a kit;
(c) any exempt product;
[F214(d) the supply of a controlled drug by or on the prescription of a practitioner, a supplementary
prescriber, a nurse independent prescriber [F215, registered chiropodist or registered
podiatrist, paramedic independent prescriber, therapeutic radiographer independent
prescriber] or a pharmacist independent prescriber;]
(e) the supply of a controlled drug for administration in a clinical trial or a medicinal test on
animals.
[F216(3) In this regulation—
F217...
“medicinal test on animals” has the same meaning as in the Medicines Act 1968.]
